item.title: Show HN: Fun Web page 3D visualization of laundry room status
item.summary: By default, this shows simulated data. It can show real data, but we don't want to hug-of-death the laundry company IoT. Click on a machine, to see how the apartment building attendant responds to people leaving their laundry for hours in high-contention machines. This was a collaboration with Claude Code. Sometimes Claude wasted time frustratingly, sometimes Claude saved lots of time. The end product is good enough, the Easter eggs were fun, and it was completed in less time than I could've done it myself.
